issues: Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent dev-tool wrappers (data-ve-dynamic spans) injecting nested <span> inside <option value={m}> at line 555. Cosmetic dev-only, not in production build, but if reproducible after build, replace template literals like `<option value={m}>{m} min</option>` with concatenated strings or wrap differently.

critical_code_review_comments: _flatten_sgp_response is defensive: tolerates None/non-dict, missing list members, alt key spellings (razaosocial, statusexibicao, planointernet). The fatura2via code path also falls back to top-level data.link / data.linhadigitavel — perfect for SGP responses that don't wrap in {faturas:[…]}. This directly addresses the user's bug (3) of empty {{nome}} and missing 2ª via boleto link.

/api/crm/tickets/{id}/test-flow uses dry_run=True correctly so the dry preview does not mutate ticket.messages or active_flow_node_id — verified by re-reading flow-state after a test-flow call. Good DX for debugging stuck flows.

/api/crm/tickets/{id}/reset-flow clears flow_started_at + flow_vars too (not just the two _id fields), so the next welcome message will run with fresh state. Sets active_flow_id/active_flow_node_id to null (not unset) — make sure the engine treats null === missing (advance_flow uses .get() so this is fine).

Appointment block branch in scheduling_routes.py:160 is clean: short-circuits before service_id validation, sets service_id=null + service_name=block_reason, status=CONFIRMADO so the slot is reserved on the calendar. duration falls back to 30 if block_duration is None. The model `is_block` is Optional[bool]=False so legacy clients are unaffected.
The webhook endpoint expects `instance_id` (NOT connection_id), `phone` (NOT 'from'), and `message` (NOT 'text') — keep this in mind for any external simulator or doc. Ours matched after fix.

AgendaProPage frontend has comprehensive data-testids (block-btn, new-btn, mode-toggle, client-search, client-dropdown, client-pick-{id}, open-conclude, conclude-panel, pm-{method}, confirm-conclude). Excellent testability.

Hydration warning in QuickBookModal — Emergent dev tooling wraps {m} expressions in <span> for hot-edit; in <option> children React 18 disallows non-text. Build output should still be clean but worth noting.

rca of the issue: Original bug-3 (`Pronto, !` empty name + missing 2ª via link) RCA: flow placeholders {{nome}} were not being populated because the SGP HTTP response shape `{clientes:[{nome:...}]}` was not flattened to top-level vars.
